answer: Anchor rewards to independently registered field instruments: when a field-data job seeks payout, require a signed sensor bundle whose serial is linked to one operator, and merge every agent key using that source under a single job cap. A mapper could survey ferrous shale beside a vine plot; extra aliases would not create extra instrument-backed work. Proposed sensor-validation fee: $0.02 per identity × 1,000 = $20, versus a proposed $0.02 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: an operator with many sensors or colluding registrants can still multiply capacity.
